title: 12-name watchlist · 06 Nov 2026 (Fri) · 16:00 SGT
summary: Three new items: Tesla factory plans, reported NVIDIA packaging funding and Taiwan-session context for TSMC. All 12 USD prices and 72 adjusted-close baselines were rechecked. Prices remain the completed 5 November US session, not live quotes.
coverage_note: Window: 6 November 07:45–16:00 SGT, including the 15-minute overlap. Reuters evidence is article text or a substantial excerpt retrieved through search, not successfully opened article pages. Primary issuer coverage remains partial and is qualified by name. Prior canonical stories were deduplicated across all saved editions. The previous successful report cutoff was 6 November 08:00 SGT; this report covers the intervening eight hours. No new accepted filings appeared in 11 successfully checked SEC feeds. Amazon SEC coverage remains unavailable. Earlier editions and full reports are retained.
price_basis: USD saved regular-session closes for 5 Nov 2026, the latest completed US session at the cutoff. Fresh Yahoo daily bars and regularMarketTime metadata confirm all 12 closes and exact vendor quote timestamps. Daily changes compare ordinary closes with 4 Nov ordinary closes; adjusted closes are separate return endpoints. BRK.B vendor time is 21:04:07 UTC; other quote times are 21:00:01 or 21:00:02 UTC. Postmarket prices are excluded. Prices are saved observations, not live. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR.
return_basis: Six cumulative 1–6 month returns use Yahoo adjusted closes, adjusted for splits and dividend/capital-gain distributions. Formula: (endpoint adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1) x 100. Source values are rounded to cents before independent Decimal arithmetic; percentages are rounded to two decimals. Baselines are the latest available sessions on or before each monthly anniversary: 5 Oct, 4 Sep, 5 Aug, 2 Jul, 5 Jun and 5 May 2026. Returns are not annualised and exclude investor fees, tax and FX.
caveats: News coverage is partial. Reuters article text or a substantial excerpt was available through search, but direct article opens were inaccessible. Primary-source access and usable publication times varied by company; missing verified news does not establish no news.
Amazon SEC submissions and Micron investor-relations endpoints previously returned HTTP 403 and were not retried. The source checks do not claim exhaustive coverage.
The included Reuters reports appeared after the saved 5 November US close. They must not be used as confirmed causes of those closing-price moves.

NVIDIA financing is reported from an unnamed source and remains unconfirmed. Tesla production is a reported management plan, not a completed change. TSMC market context refers to Taiwan shares, not an updated USD ADR quote.
Cents-first adjusted-close calculations are reproducible from displayed values and can differ by 0.01 percentage point from calculations using unrounded vendor values.
